children: TOMI Environmental Solutions announced conversion of $2,475,000 of convertible notes into 1,649,989 shares, lifting shareholders' equity to about $3.8 million.
$2,475,000 aggregate principal of convertible notes converted into 1,649,989 shares of common stock.
Shareholders' equity stood at approximately $3.8 million as of September 1, 2026.
Equity now exceeds the $2.5 million Nasdaq minimum under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1).
No assurance the Nasdaq Hearings Panel will determine the company has regained compliance.
